secrets.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Stripe endpoint signing secret (whsec_...) used to verify Stripe-Signature on /webhook/stripe. Copy it from the Stripe Dashboard webhook endpoint, or from `stripe listen --forward-to localhost:8000/webhook/stripe` for local CLI forwarding. Required at boot: the settings model has no default.

secrets.name: INTERNAL_API_KEY_HASHES
secrets.description: Optional. Comma-separated SHA-256 hex digests of the X-API-Key values accepted by /internal/webhook/replay/{event_id}. Leave empty to keep that operational endpoint locked (it answers 401).
